body.p: . Runtime v0.27.1 (commit 10eb5ac1), copied unmodified to third_party/tree-sitter/ (LICENSE, lib/include, lib/src; details in third_party/tree-sitter/VERSION). Built as sxml_tree_sitter from the single unit lib/src/lib.c with TREE_SITTER_FEATURE_WASM undefined. tree-sitter-cli 0.27.1 is pinned in tools/package.json (npm ci --prefix tools); tools/generate-grammars.sh regenerates grammars/<language>/src/ and sxml_add_grammar(<language>) (cmake/SxmlGrammar.cmake) builds it as sxml_grammar_<language>. Runtime and CLI versions move together.
